title: A map of Venus from Galileo images, February 1990

statements.text: Björn Jónsson, from NASA/JPL Galileo images
statements.scope: The cloud map: 21 Galileo images from the February 1990 Venus flyby, mosaicked, cleaned and colorized by the author.

statements.text: Publicly available; no permission needed; credit "created by Björn Jónsson". The author asks sites to link to his maps, not to host a copy.
The map shows features seen in ultraviolet light; the color is added. In visible light Venus is almost white with little contrast.
statements.scope: Color and contrast of the cloud map.
